spans.s:
mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्कं)
1 Mud, mire, clay.
2 Sin.
E.
पचि to spread, aff. घञ् and च changed to क.

m. (-टः)
Soft mud, especially such as is left by the retiring of floods, or on the banks of a river, a marsh, a quagmire.
E.
पङ्क mud, कर्व्वट the capital of a district.

m. (-रः)
A lap-wing.
E.
पङ्क mud, and कीर a parrot.

mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
Wallowing, sporting in mud.
m. (-डः)
A pig.
E.
पङ्क mud, and क्रीड who sports.

m. (-कः)
A small fish, (Macrognathus Pancalus, HAM.)
E.
पङ्क mud, and गडक another fish.

f. (-तिः)
The Pancāl fish: see the last.
E.
पङ्क mud, and गति going.

m. (-हः)
The Makara, a marine monster.
E.
पङ्क mud, and ग्राह a shark.

n. (जं)
A lotus.
E.
पङ्क mud, ज born.

n. (-न्म)
A lotus.
E.
पङ्क mud, and जन्मन् birth; also पङ्केज, &c.

f. (-नी)
A pool or pond where the lotus grows, or a place abounding with that flower.
2 The flexible stalk of a water-lily.
E.
पङ्गज a lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-णः)
The residence of the lowest and most impure tribes.
E.
पचि to spread, युच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Muddiness, the nature or property of mud.
E.
तल् added to पङ्क; also with त्व, पङ्कत्व.

m. (-मः)
One of the divisions of hell.
E.
पङ्क, and धूम smoke.

f. (-भा)
A hell, the hell of mud or mire.
E.
पङ्क, and प्रभा light.

mfn. (-क् or -ग्)
Sunk in the mire.
E.
पङ्क, and भाज् what shares.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Muddy, laden with mud.
E.
पङ्क, and भारक burthened.

m. (-कः)
A bivalve shell.
E.
पङ्क mire, मडि to ornament, aff. उक.

n. (-रुट्)
A lotus.
E.
पङ्क mud, रुह to grow, aff. क्विप्; also with क aff. पङ्करुह n. (-हं.)

m. (-सः)
A crab.
E.
पङ्क, and वास abode.

f. (-क्तिः)
A cockle.
E.
पङ्क mud, शुक्ति an oyster.

m. (-णः)
The fibrous root of a lotus.
E.
पङ्क mud, and सूरण a sort of root; also written पङ्कशूरण, and पङ्कसूरण.

m. (-रः)
1 An aquatick plant, (Vallisneria.)
2 A bridge or raised bank, forming a path amidst inundated fields.
3 Stairs, steps.
4 An aquatick plant, (Trapa bispinosa, Rox.)
E.
पङ्क mud, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Muddy, clayey.
m. (-लः)
A boat, a canoe.
E.
पङ्क mud, इलच् aff.

n. (-जं)
A lotus.
E.
पङ्के in mud, and ज born; also पङ्कज.

n. (-हं)
A lotus.
m. (-हः)
The Indian crane.
E.
पङ्के in mud, and रुह what grows; also पङ्करुह.

f. (-ङ्क्तिः-ङ्क्ती)
1 A line, a row or range.
2 A sort of metre, a stanza of four lines, each line consisting of ten syllables.
3 The number ten, (in composition, ut infra.)
4 The earth.
5 Fame, celebrity.
6 Cooking, maturing.
7 Associating with, [] eating or sitting with, especially with persons of the same caste.
8 A company, a society, an assembly.
E.
पचि to spread, to extend, to make evident, and क्तिन् aff. or पच to cook, deriv. irr.

m. (-वः)
A name of RĀVAṆA.
E.
पङ्क्ति ten, ग्रीवा a neck; the ten-necked.

m. (-रः)
An ospray.
E.
पङ्कृ, and चर who goes.

m. (-कः)
An improper person to associate with, an outcast.
E.
पङ्कृ, and दूषक who spoils.

m. (-नः)
A respectable or eminent person.
E.
पङ्कृ, and पावन who purifies.

m. (-थः)
DAŚARATHA, the father of RĀMA.
E.
पङ्क्ति ten, and रथ a car.

mfn. (-ङ्गुः-ङ्गुः-ङ्गु)
Lame, crippled, halt, one who has lost his legs, &c.
m. (-ङ्गुः)
The planet Saturn.
E.
पण to engage in business, उ aff., and अङ्गु substituted for the radical final.

m. (-लः)
A horse of a glassy or silvery white colour.

m. (-हः)
One of the signs of the zodiac: see मकर.

f. (-ता)
Deformity, mutilation.
E.
तल् added to पङ्गु.

m. (-ङ्क्त्यः)
A Brahman who is or may be worthy to eat in a respectable society at sacrifices, &c.
E.
पंक्ति an assembly, and यञ् aff.
